name: The Call to Adventure
axiom: End on one imperative the audience can start before the room empties.
trigger: Closing slides and all-hands conclusions, where agreement exists but nothing has been asked for.

steps.text: Point at the goal in one sentence.
Name the first step, small and specific.
Say who owns it and when.

antiPattern.violation: A closing slide of thanks, which converts a prepared audience into a dispersed one.
antiPattern.remediation: Replace thanks with the first step. Gratitude is a mood; a call is a move.

origin.title: The Hero with a Thousand Faces
